rows.note: Use this for a cited published source in academic or written work.

example.english: The reference list for this paper is very detailed.
example.traditional: 呢篇論文嘅參考文獻列得好詳細。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 leon6 man4 ge3 caam1 haau2 man4 hin3 lit6 dak1 hou2 coeng4 sai3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a reference book or reference work.

example.english: This reference book helped me find a lot of information.
example.traditional: 呢本參考書幫我搵到好多資料。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 caam1 haau2 syu1 bong1 ngo5 wan2 dou2 hou2 do1 zi1 liu6

rows.note: Use this for a formal referral of a person or case to another service or authority.

example.english: The doctor has sent a reference for my case to a specialist.
example.traditional: 醫生已經將我嘅個案轉介畀專科醫生。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 ngo5 ge3 go3 on3 zyun2 gaai3 bei2 zyun1 fo1 ji1 sang1
